snippet.title: DELIVERX - Official Release Trailer | 4-Player Co-op Horror
snippet.description:
Play DELIVERX now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5147980/DELIVERX/

DELIVERX is a chaotic 1–4 player online co-op horror game where your courier shift turns into a fight for survival. Load cursed packages into your truck, enter procedurally generated 5-story complexes, and deliver every order before 8:00 PM — or get sent to the secret basement.

Watch your back: 5 deadly monsters roam the halls, including a Mimic that records your friends' actual microphone voices and plays them back in the dark to lure you into a trap.

KEY FEATURES:
• 1–4 Player Online Co-op with 3D proximity voice chat & walkie-talkies
• 3 Distinct Maps (Summer, Autumn, Winter) with dynamic time of day & fog
• Procedural 5-Story Complexes — new layouts, locked doors & interiors every shift
• 5 Unique Monsters — including a blind sound-hunter and a voice-stealing Mimic
• 8 Hazardous Package Types — explosive, radioactive, heavy, musical, haunted & more
• 10 Shop Tools & 6 Courier Upgrades — crowbars, motion trackers, door wedges, defibrillators & ragdoll physics

Wishlist & Play on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5147980/DELIVERX/
